name: What factors should I consider when planning my kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when planning my kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning your kitchen layout, consider the 'work triangle' (sink, refrigerator, and stove) for optimal efficiency and flow. Think about your cooking habits, storage needs, and how you use the kitchen for entertaining or family gatherings. Important decision factors include the placement of appliances, island design, and cabinet configurations. We can help you explore various layouts, such as galley, L-shape, U-shape, or island configurations, to best suit your lifestyle and the existing architecture of your home.
